_comment: Machine-readable port of SparkDate_Brand_Source_of_Truth_1_Multi_Event.md. This is the source of truth for facts that do NOT change row to row; content/queue.csv is the day-by-day queue. scripts/lint-content-queue.js enforces every rule in here. When a fact changes, change it HERE and let the linter find the rows that contradict it -- do not fix captions one at a time.

banned_facts.description: The '28 attendees' figure is unsourced and banned everywhere. 22 (Event 1) is the only sanctioned number. A revision to 31 (American Bar & Grill door count: 26 registered + unregistered +1s) is PROPOSED but NOT APPROVED -- do not swap it in without confirming.

approved_testimonials.quote: Hosts and event setup made me relaxed and able to talk freely. Met my match there and seeing where it goes from there.

utm._note: utm_content was 'proof_rsa1' on all 45 rows, so GA4 could not attribute any individual post. It is now the row id. utm_campaign was 'Augweek3_lancaster'/'Augweek3_philly', which goes stale in September (blocker #23); it is now derived per event per month.

link_rules._note: Instagram captions never render a clickable link. IG captions must pair 'link in bio' phrasing with the utm_source=Instagram URL, never the Facebook one -- both point at the same landing page, so the wrong one silently misattributes.

universal.landing_page_warning: Organic and paid links both point at /lp. A funnel analysis found 422 paid users -> ~10 begin_checkout -> ZERO purchases there, concentrated in the Facebook/Instagram in-app browser. Organic bio-link traffic mostly opens in a real browser so it is lower-risk, but this is unresolved and worth watching.

_neutral._note: Market-agnostic tags, allowed on any event.

MC.name: Marion Court
MC.notes: MC-15 (Sep 9) recaps Marion Court but links forward to Loxleys, the event still on sale. That is intentional, not a mismatch.

TL.name: Tellus AfterDark: Singles Edition
open_issues: PRICE CONTRADICTION (blocker #14): the FACTS block says regular = $18.99 from Aug 16 onward, but the Aug 21 Reel caption says $24.99. The Eventbrite listing is the tiebreaker. Unresolved -- 24.99 recorded here because that is what shipped in the live TL-2 caption.

The live listing says 'no bell, no rotation, no timer' -- WRONG. Actual run of show: check-in and drinks, icebreaker/mingling, then 7-minute matched rounds LAST. Needs fixing on the listing itself, not just in captions.
Naming: use 'Tellus AfterDark: Singles Edition', never 'Event 3' or 'Round three' (that numbering collided with Good Good Things).

GG.name: Good Good Things
GG.notes: The brand doc flags GG's venue as 'not confirmed in any caption on file'. It IS confirmed -- the live GG-1 caption reads 'Good Good Things, 11 S 21st, Rittenhouse'. Recorded here; the brand doc's open item can be closed.
open_issues: The $24.99 that appears in GG-7 refers to LOXLEYS early bird, not GG's own $29.99 ticket (corrected 8/19, was mistakenly $18.99).

LX.name: Loxleys
open_issues: PRICE TRAP: $24.99 is Marion Court's REGULAR price but Loxleys EARLY-BIRD price. Same number, different meaning per event. Two live captions (LX-11, GG-7) had it as $18.99 by mistake; both fixed 8/19.
BLOCKER #3: the Eventbrite early-bird window must move from Sep 1 to Sep 7 11:59:59 PM. The entire Sep 7 deadline sequence depends on this one edit.
BLOCKER #4: the 2-for-1 ticket type must be live in Eventbrite before Sep 19, or the Sep 19 post promises something that does not exist.

asset_rules.naming: {row_id}[_{subtype}][_{N}of{Total}].{ext}, row_id zero-padded to two digits (MC-02.jpg, TL-01_1of3.jpg, MC-12_story.jpg)
asset_rules._naming_note: Zero-padding matters: without it MC-10 sorts before MC-2 and the folder falls out of posting order.
asset_rules._publish_format_note: Instagram's Content Publishing API accepts JPEG ONLY. Source exports are PNG in RGBA mode and cannot be handed to the API as-is; RGBA must be composited onto a background before JPEG encoding. TikTok also rejects PNG.

ig._note: No scheduling parameter exists and media containers expire after 24h, so the container must be created at publish time by the runner.

ig_story._note: A Story can be posted via API but link and countdown stickers CANNOT be attached -- that is where the link and the urgency live, so sticker Stories stay manual.

tiktok._note: UPLOAD_TO_DRAFT works without TikTok's audit; DIRECT_POST requires a 2-4 week review. Photo posts (up to 35 images) are supported, so existing 1080x1080 carousels can post with no new video.

x._note: Manual by decision (2026-08-21). The queue still writes caption_x so posting is a paste. X also killed its free tier for new developers in Feb 2026; pay-per-use is $0.20 per post containing a link, and every post here has one.
